fred.speaker: D

fred.speaker: D

fred.speaker: D

fred.speaker: D

fred.speaker: D
fred.excerpt: It was our last night at the convent, so in the morning we said good-bye, and packed everything back in Fred.

fred.speaker: D
fred.excerpt: When we came back to Fred, after shopping, there was a little note from the Ashleys!

fred.speaker: D

fred.speaker: D

fred.speaker: D
fred.excerpt: Mum and Dad came with the good news that Fred was on the ship, happily sailing out of the harbour.

camel.excerpt: The Circus had lots of horses, a zebra, two deer, ten elephants, five camels, a hippopotamus etc.

camel.speaker: F

camel.speaker: D

stork.speaker: H

stork.speaker: H

bazaar.speaker: F

mosque.speaker: D

mosque.speaker: D
mosque.excerpt: In the mosque were some men playing instruments.

elephant.speaker: F
elephant.excerpt: We also got two small elephants to go with Ganesh.

elephant.excerpt: We rode up on an elephant!

elephant.speaker: H
elephant.excerpt: In the streets of Jaipur, we saw several elephants walking in the streets, some had lovely patterns painted on them and beautiful coverings.

tiger.excerpt: We bought the most expensive seats – 5 rupees (35p) – and watched the lions and tigers getting ready.

tiger.speaker: F

tiger.speaker: D
tiger.excerpt: They told us that they had about 5 tigers.

sari.speaker: D
sari.excerpt: When we got home, I tried on a sari, and a punjab costume.

sari.speaker: H

sari.excerpt: I was borrowing an embroidered white silk sari.

sari.excerpt: Nargis and I went to collect my “choli” (sari blouse) which was being made at her tailor.

sari.speaker: D
sari.excerpt: We got a shawl for me, not a furry one, it’s  lovely bright red and should go with my sari.

fort.speaker: F
fort.excerpt: Then we went to Agra Fort.

fort.speaker: F
fort.excerpt: After that, we went to Agra Fort.

fort.speaker: D
fort.excerpt: We took Matt up to the Fort, as he hadn’t been yet.

temple.speaker: D

temple.speaker: D

monkey.speaker: F

monkey.speaker: F

monkey.excerpt: The Monkey Temple is in a wood with two streams running into a stirred up pool.

monkey.speaker: D
monkey.excerpt: We also saw a baby crocodile and some monkeys.

snake.speaker: F

snake.speaker: D

curry.speaker: D

deer.speaker: F

ashley.speaker: D

ashley.speaker: D
ashley.excerpt: We drove through Ellora village, but decided to go on to Ajanta, as the Ashleys told us the Forest Rest House was better there.

nargis.speaker: D
nargis.excerpt: On the 6th I am going to a wedding with Nargis.

nargis.excerpt: Mum had a sore throat, so we left her at home with Nargis.

nargis.speaker: D
nargis.excerpt: Nargis said that she would give me a sari if I could tie it.

nargis.speaker: D
nargis.excerpt: In the morning, I went to the hairdresser with Mum and Nargis.

nargis.speaker: D
nargis.excerpt: At last, evening came and Nargis and I got dressed.

nargis.speaker: D
nargis.excerpt: Last night we took Nargis out to dinner at “Gaylords”.

nargis.speaker: D
nargis.excerpt: Nargis and I went to collect my “choli” (sari blouse) which was being made at her tailor.

nargis.speaker: D

wedding.excerpt: She showed us lots of photos of her wedding.

wedding.speaker: D

wedding.excerpt: We saw lots of smart elephants and horses getting ready for weddings.
